# ===== 以下 3 个需手动安装 (不能直接 pip install) =====
# 需手动: cd <IsaacGym_Preview_4_Package>/isaacgym/python && pip install -e .
# isaacgym==1.0rc4
# 需手动: git clone https://github.com/leggedrobotics/legged_gym.git && cd legged_gym && pip install -e .
# legged_gym==1.0.0
# 需手动: rsl_rl 是 legged_gym 仓库的子模块, cd legged_gym && git submodule update --init && cd rsl_rl && pip install -e .
# rsl_rl==1.0.2
